title: ExRel: Learning Directed Reuse Relevance between Rich-Text K-12 Question Images with Executable Relation Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2611.21461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In K-12 education, question images combine text, mathematical expressions, diagrams, and diverse layouts. Variations in wording, conditions, answer options, or task scope can substantially alter their reuse utility despite visual similarity. We formulate this problem as directed reuse relevance, grading candidate utility as Strong, Medium, or Weak. However, generic similarity scores overlook task-specific reuse requirements, while natural supervision is dominated by Strong relations and lacks fine-grained coverage. We propose ExRel, an agentic, code-grounded framework for controllable and verifiable visual data synthesis. It reconstructs real questions into editable HTML/CSS seeds and compiles 15 relation subtypes into executable contracts specifying permitted edits, protected invariants, and query-candidate direction. translated_title: ExRel：基于可执行关系契约学习富文本K-12题目图像之间的有向复用相关性
translated_abstract: 在K-12（中小学）教育中，题目图像融合了文本、数学表达式、图表和多样化的排版布局。尽管视觉上相似，措辞、条件、答案选项或任务范围的变化都可能显著改变题目的复用价值。我们将该问题形式化为“有向复用相关性”，将候选题目对查询题目的实用性分级为强、中、弱三级。然而，通用相似度评分忽视了任务特定的复用需求，而自然监督数据又以强关系为主，缺乏细粒度的覆盖。我们提出ExRel，一个基于智能体、以代码为基础的可控且可验证的视觉数据合成框架。该框架将真实题目重建为可编辑的HTML/CSS种子，并将15种关系子类型编译为可执行契约，明确规定允许的编辑、受保护的不变量以及查询-候选之间的方向关系。合成出的样本对经过确定性的DOM/渲染验证以及目标隐藏、证据辅助的审查，并带有有界的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ExRel提出一个基于智能体与代码的可控数据合成框架，将真实K-12题目图像重建为可编辑的HTML/CSS种子，并把15种复用关系子类型编译为可执行契约，通过确定性验证生成细粒度的有向复用相关性标注数据。
en_tdlr: ExRel is an agentic, code-grounded framework that reconstructs real K-12 question images into editable HTML/CSS seeds and compiles 15 relation subtypes into executable contracts, enabling controllable and verifiable synthesis of fine-grained directed reuse relevance data.
